minor.issue: The `q` value is interpolated raw into $regex without re.escape(). Any regex metacharacter breaks search — e.g. searching an email containing '+' (delivered+tag@resend.dev) returns 0 rows even though the row exists. Also a ReDoS / expensive-regex vector from an authenticated user. Same applies to the `business` filter. Fix: re.escape(q) (Mongo: {'$regex': re.escape(q)}).

Spec says walk-in requires first_name AND (email or phone), but the server only validates the name: {'first_name':'X'} with no email and no phone returns 200 and creates a contactless registration. The rule is only enforced client-side in EventManage.addWalkin, so API/bulk callers bypass it.

No duplicate-email guard (online register returns 400 for an already-registered email; manual entry happily creates a second row for the same email on the same event) and no capacity/waitlist check — manual entry can exceed event capacity silently. Confirm whether that is intentional for staff overrides; if so it should at least warn.

payment_status from the client is not validated against PAYMENT_STATUSES (unlike PUT /registrations/{id}/payment), so an arbitrary string can be stored and will then be unreachable by the payment filter.

RegEditIn is model_dump(exclude_none=True), so a field can never be cleared — sending phone/business_name/internal_notes as null is silently ignored; the Edit dialog therefore cannot blank out a wrong value.

ui_bugs.issue: The 1400px-wide table makes the dialog itself scroll horizontally: after any focus/scroll inside the table the dialog is shifted and the left-hand content is clipped off-screen — dialog title ('Manage — …' rendered as 'lanage — …'), the tab bar, the search field and the Select/Name/Member/State/Business columns become invisible/unreachable, and the horizontal scrollbar of the inner container is not what moves. Add min-w-0 / overflow-x-hidden to DialogContent (and keep overflow-x-auto only on the table wrapper) so the Name column is always visible.
Payment status options render raw enum values ('not_applicable', 'complimentary') instead of PAYMENT_LABELS used everywhere else in the table.

React console error: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>. This will cause a hydration error.' caused by the interpolated label `Member: {s}` inside <option>. Precompute the string (`{`Member: ${s}`}`) to remove the warning.

Cancel Registration uses window.confirm() instead of the shadcn AlertDialog used elsewhere; the Check-In tab search input has no data-testid; ManualDialog/EditDialog DialogContent still missing DialogDescription (a11y warning logged on open).

issues: Archived rows are styled with bg-slate-50 but are excluded from the default list, so the styling is only visible with include_archived, which the UI never requests — there is no 'Show archived' toggle, so an archived registration can only be un-archived from the DB/API.
Bulk selection (select-all / select-<id>) exists and shows 'N selected' but there is no bulk-action bar, so the checkboxes currently do nothing.
Check-In tab shows the raw internal status strings ('walkin', 'checked_in') to staff instead of friendly labels.

action_items: re.escape() the `q` (and `business`) filter values in list_registrations — emails containing '+' are currently unsearchable and raw regex is injectable.
Enforce 'email or phone required' server-side in add_walkin (400) instead of only in the UI.
Validate manual-registration payment_status against PAYMENT_STATUSES and decide/document duplicate-email + capacity behaviour for manual entry.
Allow clearing fields in PUT /registrations/{id} (use model_dump(exclude_unset=True) with explicit-null support) so the Edit dialog can blank a value.
Fix the Manage dialog horizontal overflow so the dialog title and the Select/Name/Member/State columns are never clipped (min-w-0 / overflow-x-hidden on DialogContent).
Use PAYMENT_LABELS in the ManualDialog payment select; fix the <span> inside <option> React error in EventManage.jsx line 44.
Either add a 'Show archived' toggle (include_archived=true) or a bulk-action bar for the existing row checkboxes — both are currently dead UI.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2172 lines; the registrations block (list/manual/walk-in/edit/cancel/archive/badge/history/checkin, lines ~1376-1594) is a self-contained router and should be extracted to backend/routers/registrations.py.

_reg_and_authz correctly centralises staff-or-owner authz and is used by every new endpoint; list_registrations duplicates the same 4 lines inline — reuse a helper for the event-level check too (manual-registration and walk-in duplicate it a third and fourth time).
PUT /registrations/{id}/archive takes an untyped Dict[str, Any] body instead of a Pydantic model — inconsistent with the rest of the API and unvalidated.
checkin_registration stores prev_status but the undo branch does not clear checkin_method/checked_in_by, so an undone registration keeps stale 'walkin'/'qr' metadata.
Good: all new endpoints project {_id: 0}, audit every mutation via log_audit, and the no-op edit short-circuits before writing or auditing.

rca_of_the_issue: q filter: list_registrations builds {'$regex': q} from the raw query string, so Mongo/PCRE metacharacters are interpreted — '+' after a literal char makes the pattern require repetition and the email no longer matches, producing a silent 'no results'. Reproduction: create a reg with email delivered+abc@resend.dev, GET /api/events/evt_246d20a66b31/registrations?q=delivered+abc@resend.dev -> filtered 0. Mitigation: re.escape() the value. Walk-in contact rule: add_walkin only validates the composed name; the email-or-phone requirement lives solely in EventManage.addWalkin, so POST /api/events/{id}/registrations {'first_name':'X'} creates a row with empty email and null phone. UI clipping: the table's min-w-[1400px] exceeds the max-w-6xl DialogContent, and because DialogContent has only overflow-y-auto the horizontal overflow scrolls the dialog itself (centered with translate), pushing the header and the first five columns outside the viewport.
